definition: sources: keyed by BUILTIN.DF(customer.leadsource); NULL leadsource -> 'Untracked'. customers: COUNT(customer.id) of Customers (subsidiary 2, stage LIKE 'CUSTOMER%', firstorderdate NOT NULL, category NOT IN (2 Garage Experts, 14 Vendor)) created in this cohort month (TO_CHAR(datecreated,'YYYY-MM')), grouped by customer.leadsource. records: COUNT(customer.id) of ALL customer-table records (leads, prospects and customers) created in the month under the same subsidiary/category filters, grouped by leadsource. m1_net_revenue: NET revenue (product only; shipping/tax excluded via i.itemtype IS NOT NULL and tl.taxline='F'; CustCred/CustRfnd deducted; SUM(-tl.foreignamount); t.type IN CustInvc/CashSale/CustCred/CustRfnd; t.subsidiary=2; tl.mainline='F') from those Customers' transactions dated in the cohort month (TO_CHAR(trandate,'YYYY-MM') = TO_CHAR(datecreated,'YYYY-MM')), grouped by the customer's leadsource. customers_m1: COUNT(DISTINCT customer) with an M1 line. m1_transactions: COUNT(DISTINCT transaction.id). untracked_customers / untracked_records: the 'Untracked' (NULL leadsource) counts repeated at top level; untracked_customer_share_pct = untracked_customers / total_customers * 100, untracked_record_share_pct likewise (denominators carried). Query: src/data/queries/source_mix.sql; queries 1-2 run once for the range, query 3 one cohort month per call. Pulled 2026-09-05.
